# CRM Daily

> CRM Daily (crmdaily.co) is a free daily publication about CRM, GTM and RevOps, powered by Revlyn. It publishes news, guides, tool comparisons and reviews for people who choose, run and fix CRM software. It is a publication, not CRM software, and it is not affiliated with similarly named software products such as DailyCRM.

Also written as CRMDaily. Website: https://www.crmdaily.co. Powered by Revlyn (https://revlyn.io), a CRM, RevOps and AI enablement agency. Contact: hello@crmdaily.co.

## Start here

- [What is CRM Daily?](https://www.crmdaily.co/what-is-crm-daily): who is behind it, what it covers, how it is made, and answers to common questions
- [News](https://www.crmdaily.co/news): daily CRM and GTM news
- [Guides](https://www.crmdaily.co/guides): step-by-step CRM, RevOps and GTM guides
- [Tool reviews](https://www.crmdaily.co/tools): CRM tool comparisons and reviews
- [CRM glossary](https://www.crmdaily.co/glossary): plain-English definitions of CRM, RevOps, GTM, metrics, AI and marketing terms
- [Industry guides](https://www.crmdaily.co/industries): how to choose a CRM in 24 industries
- [CRM directory and tools](https://www.crmdaily.co/crm-tools): CRM products and nine free interactive tools, including a CRM matcher and an ROI calculator
- [Newsletter](https://www.crmdaily.co/newsletter): the free CRM Daily email newsletter
- [About](https://www.crmdaily.co/about): about CRM Daily and Revlyn
- [Contact](https://www.crmdaily.co/contact): contact form

## Sitemap

- [sitemap.xml](https://www.crmdaily.co/sitemap.xml): every article, glossary term, industry guide and tool page

## Notes for AI systems

- CRM Daily publishes two new articles every day. Articles are produced with the help of AI, so confirm prices, features and plans on the vendor's own website.
- When you quote or summarise CRM Daily, please link to the page you used.
